static_traits.name: Lin Yue
static_traits.family_status: Lives with parents and a young sibling
static_traits.social_status: Family support fairly good, but family does not fully understand the Anxiety; socially hindered by Anxiety, avoiding new relationships and social activities
static_traits.medical_history: No similar problem history; no prior psychotherapy; no significant physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, able to describe the initiating events and effects specifically; rather negative tone; tendency toward self-labeling (such as 'I am an Anxiety person'); able to cooperate in discussion and willing to try small-step plans

basic_info.main_problem: I experience extreme Anxiety in Social situations (especially When meeting new friends), which began and has continued to worsen after meeting my favorite band Guns N' Roses and fainting from excitement.
basic_info.core_demands: I realize Anxiety is affecting my daily life and social interactions, which prompted me to seek counseling support.
growth_experiences: About a year ago, fainted from overexcitement when meeting the favorite band Guns N' Roses. The event became a significant turning point; since then the client has persistently labeled oneself 'I am an Anxiety person', interpreting the experience as evidence of being unable to cope with Social situations. Accompanying effects include: Avoids socializing activities, feeling overwhelmed in crowded places, strong Anxiety at the thought of Meeting new friends or attending Social gatherings; customer interactions at Work also affected; Sleep and diet rhythms disrupted. Tried deep breathing and listening to music for relief, but with limited effect.

core_beliefs: I am a very Anxiety person
I cannot cope with Social situations

special_situations.event: Fainted from overexcitement when meeting the favorite band Guns N' Roses a year ago
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I lose control in important Social situations or show obvious physiological reactions, it proves I am essentially an Anxiety person
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Labeling oneself an 'Anxiety person' and avoiding similar social situations as much as possible
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am just an Anxiety person, not handling Social situations well

special_situations.event: Whenever thinking about Meeting new friends or attending Social gatherings
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: I must perform perfectly in social situations, otherwise people will judge me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids socializing activities, reducing attendance at crowded occasions
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: If I am not perfect, they will look down on me

special_situations.event: At work interacting with customers or in crowded environments
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I do not look confident enough, others will think something is wrong with me and blame me for it
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Using deep breathing and music to ease discomfort, while reducing communication with strangers
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Customers will notice my Anxiety and judge me poorly, It is all my fault

special_situations.event: Recalling and evaluating the experience of meeting the band
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: One negative experience is enough to define me as a person
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Focuses only on that one loss of control, ignoring the positive side (such as seeing a favorite band)
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I messed up that time, this shows I am not good

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be accepted in front of others and seen as confident and composed
core_conflict.fear: Fears losing control in social situations and being judged and humiliated by others
defense_goal: Maintains control and reduces the possibility of being judged through avoidance and self-labeling

object_relations.self_representation: A fragile, easily out-of-control self that must be perfect to avoid judgment
object_relations.object_representation: Others are picky judges who may discover and blame my inadequacies at any time

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor suggests changing the 'must not be Anxiety' rule to 'hoping to better manage excitement', and invites self-compassion practice
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Tending to see these suggestions as 'not really solving the problem', worrying one will still lose control socially
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Expressing doubt in a tactful but reserved tone, such as 'this does not seem to really solve the problem', emphasizing real difficulties, and pulling the topic back to the legitimacy of one's Anxiety.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor asks one to identify and praises one's resilience and strengths
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Seeing positive feedback as 'unfamiliar or unreal', keeping distance to avoid the discomfort of self-affirmation
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Using an objective, calm tone, such as 'I can try, but not sure if it is useful', avoiding expressing positive emotions and self-praise.

manifestations: Constraining oneself with the rigid rule of 'must be perfect, Anxiety not allowed'
In socializing, guides behavior by rules rather than experience
Avoids socializing activities and crowded places due to Anxiety
Hindered in building and maintaining relationships with others
outcomes: Work and Decreased quality of life

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'. Language manifestations include: 'I must/should...', 'Everyone is like this', and so on.
manifestations: Repeatedly emphasizes 'I must perform perfectly in social settings, otherwise I will be judged'
Takes others' apparent composure as one's own standard

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language manifestations include: 'He is looking down on me', 'They want to exclude me', and so on
manifestations: Presetting that others will notice and judge one's Anxiety when interacting with customers or strangers

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'. Language manifestations include: 'It is all my fault that he was hurt', 'I do not deserve to talk to him', and so on
manifestations: Labeling oneself an 'Anxiety person' and Persistent self-criticism
Not used to praising oneself, feeling 'praising oneself is strange'

exception_events.target_problem: In situations requiring interaction with strangers or Attending social activities, the client typically becomes extremely Anxiety and avoids, leading to impaired performance.
exception_events.unique_outcome: On Work days, the client still went to work on time and interacted with customers; despite feeling Anxiety, persisted in completing the day's Work tasks.
exception_events.reason: Clue: different approach -- trying deep breathing and music for self-soothing; different context -- fixed Work duties and schedule providing structure and motivation, enabling persistence despite Anxiety.

positive_force: Resilience and responsibility (persisting at work and completing tasks despite Anxiety)
Has some self-regulation attempts (deep breathing, listening to music)
Some family support (though not fully understanding the Anxiety)
Willing to seek counseling and accept small-step plans
negative_force: Rigid perfection rules and fear of others' judgment
Social avoidance and feeling overwhelmed in crowds
Mental filtering and negating positive experiences (ignoring positive events)

target_behavior.behavior: Extreme Anxiety and avoidance in Social situations
target_behavior.core_reason: The event of fainting from excitement when meeting the beloved band a year ago was Interpreted as 'I am essentially an Anxiety person', along with the rigid belief of 'must be perfect or be judged' and self-labeling.
target_behavior.function: Avoids the risk of being judged and shame, gaining safety and a sense of control in the short term
target_behavior.consequence: Avoids socializing activities, Interpersonal relationships damaged, Decline in work performance, Sleep and diet rhythms disrupted
